correctness.rationale: Prime-power sum identity for even m reduces Qn congruence to avoidance of n divisible by a_p=p(p-1)/gcd(Q,p-1) for primes p not dividing Q. As 1806=42*43, N_42 equals common sieve U with 43∤n; N_1806 removes new exceptional moduli b_k=k(43k+1)/gcd(42,k) at primes 43k+1. Common moduli are coprime to 43; CRT gives delta42=(42/43)u. Both sieve tails have summable reciprocal moduli; hence natural densities exist. Independently enumerated 21 small common primes and 109 exceptional primes 43k+1 at even k<=1000, using exact fractions: C<227/1000, S<=1000<9/2000. Elementary tails u>353/1000 and S<9/2000+42/43000 give delta1806-delta42>47/17200>1/400. These exact computations are certified finite facts; summable tails and CRT establish infinite claim.
